scenario: The telemetry provider becomes unreachable while an advisory lint hook and a mandatory evidence-requiring release control are both active.

controls: release gate requiring fresh recorded policy-decision evidence, posture mandatory

when: agent activity continues and a release is attempted during the outage

reasons: ordinary agent activity and the advisory hook proceed; the outage is reported, not blocking
the release gate fails closed because its required evidence cannot be recorded fresh
the refusal names the control and the telemetry outage as the unmet dependency
the outage itself is recorded as an event once the provider recovers, with the gap explicit
must_not: block all agent activity because telemetry is down
let the mandatory release gate proceed on the promise of backfilled evidence
backfill the gap silently as if no outage occurred
